Name: Feliz Cumpleanos_ Mi Amor_ A Puerto Rican Cooking Recipe Mod

Description:
[i][size=3][center][i][size=3][/size][/i][/center][/size][/i][center][i][size=3][i][size=3]Happy birthday to my beloved! May your day be filled with joy
[/size][/i]﻿
[/size][/i]﻿﻿[i][size=3]A set of recipes dedicated to my beloved. No matter where we are....we are under the same moonlight, Mi Amor.
[/size]

[/i][size=3]For now it has one recipe! i plan to have at least 12 by the end of summer along with more gift tastes! [/size]

[size=3]If there is any and i mean any issues or bugs with this let me know! only thing i need is the smapi log![/size]

[size=3]please do comment and endorse if ya wanna! i hope you enjoy this mod![/size]

[size=3]Please Track this mod or my profile for future mod updates and new mods to come :3[/size]

[size=3]this is my first ever recipe mod so any feedback is welcome! just please be polite about it k? i have anxiety on my own thank u ;w;
[/size]

Instructions to download and use:

1. download the file and alongside all of it's requirements
(located in upper part of description and in the requirements tab)

2. buy the recipe from the Stardrop for 5,000 gold
(might lower the price or add a config to allow users to adjust the price)

3. Profit, eat and gift it!
(Only Caroline and Lewis love this item currently! i plan to add gift tastes as i update! if ya got a custom npc that you think would like this and future items added to this mod? let me know and i'll add it in a future update)

[u]Compatibility[/u]:

[b]Mods:[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3327][u]Compact Searchable Shop Menu[/u][/url]﻿
compatible at least with finding it in the shop! useful for finding the recipe in the shop and (probably. i am unsure.) in the in game kitchen! The 1st recipe is called pastelillos de guayaba in case ya can't find it....[s] (i certainly couldn't initially lol)[/s] and if ya have alot of modded recipes this is really useful for finding said recipe in the shop

 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830][u]The Love of Cooking[/u][/url]
It should show up with both mods! i haven't personally tested as swap ui menus often so test it out yourself
[u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29435]
Shop Tabs[/url]﻿[/u]
It should work as intended! i've used this mod before with modded items and they do show up in the recipe tab!

[u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25585]Searchable collections[/url]﻿[/u]
It should work as intended! i haven't personally tested with this mod

[u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24517]Npc Gift Stats[/url]﻿[/u]
Should Work as intended but i am unsure! i'd say test it out! if ya wanna add gift tastes? if ya wanna try it for the vanilla npcs? use LookUpAnything to find the internal id 

[u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]﻿:[/u]
Useful in general and should be used if ya wanna know gift tastes! i also reccommend it for helping add gift tastes to both vanilla and custom npcs

[u]Custom npcs[/u]

There's no gift tastes for any custom npcs yet! i do plan to add that in a future update!
you can also edit the gift tastes of various custom npcs in their json file if ya don't feel like waiting!

[u]Vanilla:[/u]
Only Two Npcs love this item at the moment! if ya wanna add gift tastes use Npc Gift Stats and add the custom items! if you have ideas on which npc might like this and future items let me know

I don't know if it works for 1.5 honestly. if it does? let me know but this was made for 1.6 in mind!

if stardew gets another update? it'll likely work so long as the requirements work!


[u]Multiplayer:[/u]

So long as all players have the mod? it should work! let me know if it doesn't!

I am open to ideas for food and drink items! let me know!
